title: data/snapshots/<server>/<ISO>.json
description: Written BEFORE merging into data/servers.json, on every ingest. diff.js compares the two most recent snapshots for a server.

takenAt.description: Ingest time, not dump-capture time. Also encoded in the filename.

capturedAt.description: When the dump itself was taken, if the dump says so. Preferred over takenAt for ordering when present.

sourceSha256.description: Of the raw file. Ingest is idempotent: an unchanged sha for the same server writes no new snapshot.

warnings.description: Sections skipped or malformed. Parsers warn and carry on; they never throw.

record.description: The server record exactly as parsed from this one dump, before merge.
